title: Croatian Quinoa Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious quinoa pilaf dish inspired by the flavors of Croatia. This hearty pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the quinoa and pilaf, stirring to combine.
Add the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in chopped fresh parsley.
